description:
Create variable-width buffer zones around roads based on their noise impact distance.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the layer /home/ga/GIS_Data/roads_noise_attributed.geojson.
3. This layer contains a field called 'impact_dist' which defines the buffer radius (in meters) for each road segment.
4. Use the Buffer tool (Vector > Geoprocessing Tools > Buffer) or the 'Variable distance buffer' tool to create buffers.
5. CRITICAL: Instead of typing a fixed distance, you must use the 'impact_dist' field to define the buffer distance for each feature. Look for the 'Data defined override' button next to the Distance field or select the field directly if using the Variable Distance tool.
6. Export the result as GeoJSON to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/variable_buffers.geojson.
